outlook.body:
- Maintains a diversified pharmaceutical product portfolio
- Focuses on manufacturing excellence through quality systems and compliant production for domestic and international partners
- Operates a dedicated R&D centre focused on formulation development and improving operational efficiency
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The Company owns two wind turbines at Jaisalmer, Rajasthan with a combined capacity of 1.6 MW; the electricity generated is sold on the Indian Energy Exchange. No new capex or expansion project with a commissioning/completion timeline was disclosed in this section.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Rising demand for prescription medicines fuelled by increasing prevalence of chronic and lifestyle-related conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular disorders, obesity and CNS disorders
- Structural shift in the Indian healthcare market towards preventive healthcare, wellness, specialized therapeutics and digitally enabled healthcare services
- Rising disposable incomes, increasing healthcare awareness, expanding insurance penetration and favourable demographics expected to continue strengthening the pharmaceutical industry
- China-plus-one shift seen as a significant opportunity for India to become a preferred pharmaceutical manufacturing destination and capture a growing share of global outsourcing
- Management flags geopolitical frictions, tariff volatility, supply chain dependencies, regulatory constraints, pricing pressures and rising input-cost inflation as ongoing causes of concern
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers
